title: Forecasting the Winner of a Live Tennis Match
abstract: arXiv:2609.07617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the rise of live sports betting in recent years, tennis forecasting has expanded from pre-match prediction to models that update win probabilities as a match unfolds. A central challenge in creating such a model is the constant need for models to adapt to score and performance changes. This study examines how pre-match and live information can be most effectively integrated into a model to produce accurate win-probability estimates. The analysis uses 8,222 Grand Slam matches containing a total of 1,505,355 points. Five models were evaluated using a chronological split, with matches from 2011-2021 used for training, 2022 for validation, and 2023-2024 for testing. Trace, a hybrid model, achieved accuracies of 76.06%, 82.15%, and 88.34% at 25%, 50%, and 75% match progress, suggesting that hybrid modeling is a practical approach to live tennis forecasting.

translated_title: 预测正在进行的网球比赛的获胜者
translated_abstract: 随着近年来体育实时投注的兴起，网球预测已从赛前预测扩展到在比赛进行过程中实时更新获胜概率的模型。构建此类模型的一个核心挑战是模型需要不断适应比分和球员表现的变化。本研究探讨了如何最有效地将赛前信息和实时信息整合到模型中，以产生准确的获胜概率估计。分析使用了8,222场大满贯比赛，共包含1,505,355个得分。研究采用时间顺序划分评估了五个模型，其中2011-2021年的比赛用于训练，2022年用于验证，2023-2024年用于测试。Trace作为一种混合模型，在比赛进行到25%、50%和75%时分别达到了76.06%、82.15%和88.34%的准确率，表明混合建模是实时网球比赛预测的一种实用方法。
tldr: 提出了一种名为Trace的混合模型，通过有效整合赛前信息与实时比赛数据来预测网球比赛获胜概率，在大满贯比赛数据上于比赛进行25%、50%和75%时分别取得76.06%、82.15%和88.34%的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Trace, a hybrid model that integrates pre-match and live information to forecast tennis match win probabilities, achieving accuracies of 76.06%, 82.15%, and 88.34% at 25%, 50%, and 75% match progress on Grand Slam data.
